ancestors_knowledge.description: Children are born already carrying the heritage of their parents
ancestors_knowledge.flavor: Their path is already written by the past
ancestors_knowledge.name: Ancestors Knowledge

armorsmith_mastery.description: Increases the likelihood of crafting legendary armors
armorsmith_mastery.flavor: Their steel tells tales of victories yet to come
armorsmith_mastery.name: Armorsmith Mastery

attentive_readers.description: People won't receive negative effects from reading!
attentive_readers.flavor: The written word is never just black and white
attentive_readers.name: Attentive Readers

axe_lovers.description: This culture has a strong affinity for axes in battle
axe_lovers.flavor: Trees fear them. Enemies fear them more
axe_lovers.name: Axe Lovers

bow_lovers.description: Bow mastery is a key aspect of this culture's identity
bow_lovers.flavor: Their arrows write poetry in the wind
bow_lovers.name: Bow Lovers

buildings_spread.description: Buildings are constructed with little regard for order or planning
buildings_spread.flavor: A city that grows as unpredictably as nature itself
buildings_spread.name: Spread Out Buildings

city_layout_architects_eye.description: Buildings are placed in rings, with the pattern depending on proximity to the world's center
city_layout_architects_eye.flavor: Each stone follows the grand design
city_layout_architects_eye.name: Architect's Eye

city_layout_bricks.description: Buildings are positioned like bricks in a wall
city_layout_bricks.flavor: Order breeds strength in their foundations
city_layout_bricks.name: Bricks

city_layout_claws.description: A diagonal grid layout defines the city
city_layout_claws.flavor: Their streets slash through the landscape
city_layout_claws.name: Claws

city_layout_cross.description: Buildings are arranged in a cross pattern
city_layout_cross.flavor: Four winds guide their city's heart
city_layout_cross.name: Cross

city_layout_diamond.description: Buildings are placed in a diamond pattern
city_layout_diamond.flavor: Cities as radiant as the gems that inspire it
city_layout_diamond.name: Diamond

city_layout_honeycomb.description: The city follows a hexagonal-inspired layout
city_layout_honeycomb.flavor: Nature's perfect pattern builds perfect cities
city_layout_honeycomb.name: Honeycomb

city_layout_iron_weave.description: The city layout is a woven lattice of buildings
city_layout_iron_weave.flavor: Each building strengthens the unbreakable foundation of the city
city_layout_iron_weave.name: Iron Weave

city_layout_madman_labyrinth.description: A layout that defies logic and order
city_layout_madman_labyrinth.flavor: Only the truly mad can understand this city plan
city_layout_madman_labyrinth.name: Madman Labyrinth

city_layout_monolith_mesh.description: Buildings are arranged in a grand lattice pattern
city_layout_monolith_mesh.flavor: A design that honors the very essence of existence. Without realising it
city_layout_monolith_mesh.name: Monolith Mesh

city_layout_parallels.description: Buildings are arranged in parallel rows
city_layout_parallels.flavor: Like the strings of a finely-tuned instrument
city_layout_parallels.name: Parallels

city_layout_pebbles.description: The buildings are organized in a tightly packed grid
city_layout_pebbles.flavor: Like pebbles scattered by the wind
city_layout_pebbles.name: Pebbles

city_layout_pillars.description: The city's design follows strict vertical lines
city_layout_pillars.flavor: Like saplings stretching toward the sun
city_layout_pillars.name: Forest

city_layout_raindrops.description: The layout mimics the natural flow of raindrops
city_layout_raindrops.flavor: Cities grow like daisies in the morning dew
city_layout_raindrops.name: Raindrops

city_layout_rings.description: Buildings are arranged in concentric rings
city_layout_rings.flavor: Their cities echo the eternal dance of celestial bodies
city_layout_rings.name: Rings

city_layout_royal_checkers.description: The layout follows the pattern of a checkers board
city_layout_royal_checkers.flavor: Every building stands as a symbol of might
city_layout_royal_checkers.name: Royal Checkers

city_layout_silk_web.description: Buildings form a delicate lattice of streets
city_layout_silk_web.flavor: Every path leads to beauty in their design
city_layout_silk_web.name: Silk Web

city_layout_stone_garden.description: Buildings are placed in neat, organized grids
city_layout_stone_garden.flavor: Like stones in a garden, every building has its place
city_layout_stone_garden.name: Stone Garden

city_layout_the_grand_arrangement.description: Buildings are placed in a perfect arrangement
city_layout_the_grand_arrangement.name: Grand Arrangement

city_layout_tile_moonsteps.description: Each building is placed with subtle vertical variation from the center
city_layout_tile_moonsteps.flavor: Their cities rise and fall like lunar tides
city_layout_tile_moonsteps.name: Moonsteps

city_layout_tile_wobbly_pattern.description: Buildings are centered within zones but placed loosely within each
city_layout_tile_wobbly_pattern.name: Wobbly Pattern

city_layout_titan_footprints.description: Buildings are arranged in a large, expansive grid pattern
city_layout_titan_footprints.flavor: Designed to accommodate even the titans' stride
city_layout_titan_footprints.name: Titan Footprints

conscription_female_only.description: Only females are conscripted into the military
conscription_female_only.flavor: Their battlecries shake the heavens themselves
conscription_female_only.name: Female Conscription

conscription_male_only.description: Only males are conscripted into the military
conscription_male_only.flavor: Every son bears the weight of their defense
conscription_male_only.name: Male Conscription

craft_doctor_staff.description: A tool for medical miracles and magical cures
craft_doctor_staff.flavor: Life dances to their healing song
craft_doctor_staff.name: Doctor Staff

craft_druid_staff.description: A tool for druids to commune with the earth
craft_druid_staff.flavor: The forest answers when you listen
craft_druid_staff.name: Druid Staff

craft_evil_staff.description: Knowledge to craft the staff of the evil arts
craft_evil_staff.flavor: Wield it, and let the evil guide your soul
craft_evil_staff.name: Evil Staff

craft_flame_weapon.description: The art of forging weapons imbued with the fierce power of fire
craft_flame_weapon.flavor: The power is born in flames and ends in ashes
craft_flame_weapon.name: Flame Weapon

craft_ice_weapon.description: Masters of forging weapons that harness the biting cold
craft_ice_weapon.flavor: Their blades bring winter's bitter kiss
craft_ice_weapon.name: Ice Weapon

craft_necro_staff.description: Secrets of crafting of weapons that imbued with the voices of the dead
craft_necro_staff.flavor: Death itself serves their dark purpose
craft_necro_staff.name: Necromancer Staff

craft_shotgun.description: Allows the creation of shotguns with the raw power to defy magic
craft_shotgun.flavor: A single shot, louder than any incantation
craft_shotgun.name: Shotgun

craft_white_staff.description: Skilled in the creation of staffs that amplify divine magic
craft_white_staff.flavor: When forged, it serves as a conduit for miracles and protection
craft_white_staff.name: White Staff

dense_dwellings.description: More houses are constructed within city limits
dense_dwellings.flavor: Personal space is just a wasteful luxury
dense_dwellings.name: Dense Dwellings

diplomatic_ascension.description: The culture values diplomacy, selecting the most diplomatic individuals for leadership
diplomatic_ascension.flavor: Words shape their future more than any sword
diplomatic_ascension.name: Diplomatic Ascension

elder_reverence.description: Older people often receive gifts from their family and friends
elder_reverence.flavor: Each wrinkle earns another gift of respect
elder_reverence.name: Elder Reverence

ethno_sculpted.description: The people carry the mark of the divine sculptor
ethno_sculpted.flavor: Perfection leaves no room for choice
ethno_sculpted.name: Ethno Sculpted

ethnocentric_guard.description: They see other cultures as inferior
ethnocentric_guard.flavor: Their pride blinds them to outside wisdom
ethnocentric_guard.name: Ethnocentric Guard

expansionists.description: This culture rapidly claims and occupies land
expansionists.flavor: All your land are belong to us!
expansionists.name: Expansionists

expertise_exchange.description: Talking becomes a source of learning and experience
expertise_exchange.flavor: A good conversation is worth a thousand lessons!
expertise_exchange.name: Expertise Exchange

fames_crown.description: The most renowned and celebrated heir inherits the throne
fames_crown.flavor: Legends are built on echoes, not always truths
fames_crown.name: Fame's Crown

fast_learners.description: They acquire new skills at double the usual rate!
fast_learners.flavor: While others walk the path of knowledge, they run
fast_learners.name: Fast Learners

golden_rule.description: The wealthiest heir takes the throne
golden_rule.name: Golden Rule

gossip_lovers.description: Gossiping is a beloved pastime that brings happiness
gossip_lovers.flavor: Even the walls have stories to share in these lands
gossip_lovers.name: Gossip Lovers

grin_mark.description: Marked for death by the Grin Reaper. Their end is near
grin_mark.flavor: They laugh because it's already too late not to
grin_mark.name: Grin Mark

hammer_lovers.description: Hammers are the preferred tool for crushing their foes
hammer_lovers.flavor: Problems look like nails to their eyes
hammer_lovers.name: Hammer Lovers

happiness_from_war.description: War brings a unique sense of joy to this culture
happiness_from_war.flavor: Nothing makes them smile like the drums of battle
happiness_from_war.name: Happiness from War

hive_society.description: The hive mentality results in densely packed housing
hive_society.flavor: There's no such thing as too close!
hive_society.name: Hive Society

join_or_die.description: Enemies on the brink of death may switch sides instead of perishing
join_or_die.flavor: A life spared is a life owned
join_or_die.name: Join or Die

legacy_keepers.description: They focus solely on maintaining their legacy, avoiding change at all costs
legacy_keepers.flavor: Ancestral wisdom becomes their unshakable truth
legacy_keepers.name: Legacy Keepers

matriarchy.description: The culture is governed by a matriarchal system, with females prioritized for leadership!
matriarchy.name: Matriarchy

patriarchy.description: The culture is governed by a patriarchal system, with males prioritized for leadership!
patriarchy.name: Patriarchy

pep_talks.description: People can get inspired after talks
pep_talks.flavor: A single word can change the course of battle!
pep_talks.name: Pep Talks

reading_lovers.description: Reading is a beloved activity that brings happiness
reading_lovers.flavor: Each page turned reveals a new world within
reading_lovers.name: Reading Lovers

roads.flavor: Where we're going, we don't need roads. But we built them anyway
roads.name: Roads

serenity_now.description: People focus on present tranquility, never starting wars
serenity_now.flavor: Patience, deep breaths, and letting go of drama
serenity_now.name: Serenity Now

shattered_crown.description: Power is divided equally among heirs
shattered_crown.flavor: A crown worn by many heads seldom stays whole
shattered_crown.name: Shattered Crown

solitude_seekers.description: They prefer solitude and isolation and build fewer houses
solitude_seekers.flavor: They prefer a quiet life, but sometimes loneliness is their only neighbor
solitude_seekers.name: Solitude Seekers

spear_lovers.description: These people prefer using spears for fights
spear_lovers.flavor: They strike before swords can sing
spear_lovers.name: Spear Lovers

statue_lovers.description: The culture delights in creating statues!
statue_lovers.name: Statue Lovers

sword_lovers.description: The sword symbolizes courage and honor in this culture
sword_lovers.flavor: A sword's true strength lies not in the blade, but in the heart of the wielder!
sword_lovers.name: Sword Lovers

tiny_legends.description: Children begin contributing to work from an early age
tiny_legends.flavor: No age is too young for greatness!
tiny_legends.name: Tiny Legends

tower_lovers.description: They build more towers than they need
tower_lovers.flavor: The view is always better from above
tower_lovers.name: Tower Lovers

training_potential.description: This culture values training, giving double progress with each level-up
training_potential.flavor: Each step in training is a step closer to becoming legends
training_potential.name: Training Potential

true_roots.description: Deep respect for origins prevents cultural, religious and linguistic conversion
true_roots.flavor: No, seriously. Don't try to change them
true_roots.name: True Roots

ultimogeniture.description: Succession follows the youngest, ensuring fresh leadership
ultimogeniture.flavor: Youth guides them toward tomorrow's dawn
ultimogeniture.name: Ultimogeniture

unbroken_chain.description: Prevents the kingdom from shattering into multiple realms by appointing a new ruling clan when no heirs remain
unbroken_chain.flavor: The chain of power bends but never breaks
unbroken_chain.name: The Unbroken Chain

warriors_ascension.description: The culture values warrior prowess, selecting the best warriors for leadership
warriors_ascension.flavor: Blood and steel forge tomorrow's rulers
warriors_ascension.name: Warriors Ascension

weaponsmith_mastery.description: Increases the likelihood of crafting legendary weapons
weaponsmith_mastery.flavor: They don't just make weapons - they make history!
weaponsmith_mastery.name: Weaponsmith Mastery

xenophiles.description: They find strength in diversity and unity in differences
xenophiles.flavor: Every strange face brings a new tale to their halls
xenophiles.name: Xenophiles

xenophobic.description: Xenophobia runs deep in this culture, often leading them into needless conflicts
xenophobic.flavor: They're masters at turning potential friends into enemies
xenophobic.name: Xenophobic

youth_reverence.description: Younger people are showered with gifts and spared from work until grown
youth_reverence.flavor: Their laughter is their only task
youth_reverence.name: Youth Reverence
